audit.description: Changed production code in appstoreserverlibrary/api_client.py replaces the async client import from httpx with import aiohttp and executes requests through aiohttp.ClientSession().request. The diff also changes async dependencies from httpx to aiohttp in setup.py, requirements.txt, and egg-info metadata. Static and dynamic evidence show no source-library imports from production repo code, while dynamic target events resolve aiohttp from site-packages rather than a local provider.
evidence: appstoreserverlibrary/api_client.py: __init__ now imports aiohttp and stores it on self._aiohttp instead of creating httpx.AsyncClient().
appstoreserverlibrary/api_client.py: _execute_request uses async with self._aiohttp.ClientSession() and session.request(...).
setup.py, requirements.txt, app_store_server_library.egg-info/PKG-INFO, and requires.txt replace async dependency httpx with aiohttp.
Dynamic metrics: target_events_from_production_repo_count=32 with first target import from appstoreserverlibrary/api_client.py line 725.
Dynamic metrics: target_spec_origins for aiohttp point to after_venv_overlay site-packages/aiohttp/__init__.py and target_local_spec_count=0.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses aiohttp ClientSession for async HTTP requests.
Changed production code does not import or reference httpx.
No local fake aiohttp provider was added or used.
